title: I have gone to Mall World for as long as I can remember
content: I’m 59 years old now and I remember having these dreams since I was a kid. The older I get the more detailed Mall World is. I have friends here and a life. Most of them are pleasant albeit confusing and uniquely beautiful. I have the map in my head and it is the same maps that I have seen other people draw. I travel to other countries via airplane and boat. Sometimes I don’t reach the destination and I end up in a “back room” or the gross public bathroom. I frequently visit a huge indoor swimming pool with connecting pools. I like it there. I dream of all the places that people are mentioning. Is there any older people here like me?
